title: Count with a dict
prompt: Given words = ['a','b','a','c','b','a'], build a dict of counts with a plain loop and .get. No Counter.

title: Slice a 2D window
prompt: Given a 4x5 matrix (list of lists), return the 2x3 sub-matrix whose top-left corner is at row 1, column 2, as a list of lists.

title: Loop ranges for a sliding window
prompt: For a list of length n and a window of size k, write the for-loop header that visits every valid start index, and print each window.
expect: for i in range(n - k + 1): print(nums[i:i + k])

title: Sort with a key
prompt: Given bookings = [('ams', 120), ('ber', 80), ('par', 200)], sort by price descending, then return only the city names.
expect: ['par', 'ams', 'ber'] using sorted(..., key=lambda b: b[1], reverse=True)

title: Group into a dict of lists
prompt: Given pairs = [('nl','ams'),('de','ber'),('nl','rot')], group cities by country into a dict of lists.

title: enumerate and zip
prompt: Given names and scores (two lists of equal length), print 'rank. name: score' starting the rank at 1.
expect: for rank, (name, score) in enumerate(zip(names, scores), start=1)

title: Comprehension with a filter and an else
prompt: From nums, build (a) a list of only the even numbers squared, and (b) a list with 'even' or 'odd' for every number.
expect: [n*n for n in nums if n % 2 == 0] and ['even' if n % 2 == 0 else 'odd' for n in nums]

title: String split, strip, join
prompt: Given s = ' 2026-11-25 , AMS ,  3 nights ', return the parts stripped of spaces and joined with '|'.

title: Sum a matrix and its columns
prompt: Given a matrix, compute the total of all entries and a list with the sum of each column, with plain loops or zip(*matrix).
expect: sum(sum(row) for row in matrix) and [sum(col) for col in zip(*matrix)]

title: Function with every path returning
prompt: Write first_negative(nums) that returns the index of the first negative number, or None if there is none. Say what it returns for an empty list.
expect: None for [] and for all-positive input

title: try / except / raise
prompt: Write safe_ratio(a, b) that returns a / b, raises ValueError('b must not be zero') when b is 0, and show a caller catching it.
expect: raise ValueError(...) inside, try/except ValueError as e outside

title: Two pointers skeleton
prompt: Write the loop skeleton for two pointers moving inwards on a sorted list, stopping when they meet.
expect: left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1; while left < right: ...
